svg.desc: Alstom Headquarters LOCATION Cairo, Egypt CLIENT Alstom Transport COMPLETION EST. VALUE 2019 30 million EGP DISCIPLINES Architectural Design Structural / Civil Engineering Mechanical Engineering Electrical Engineering Project Overview Complete design and supervision of the execution for two floors: the first floor with an area of 1,680 m2 and the second floor with an area of 1,500 m2. BECT's scope included conceptual design, detailed drawings, tender documents, site supervision and project management. The multidisciplinary services covered architectural design, structural / civil engineering, mechanical engineering and electrical engineering.
